question: Can the already-audited parameterized mechanism carrier (git blob b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796, sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72) be installed byte-identically at the shipping kernel path src/spider/kernel.py such that the public shipped package `import spider` passes a pre-freeze promotion certificate on the real credential-free deterministic localhost-HTTP substrate - (a) POSITIVE: distill_parameterized over the 5 induction observations per resource type yields a mechanism whose resolve() is EXECUTABLE with a correctly bound non-null action at confidence 0.9 on UNSEEN held-out in-support identifiers (doc-013/rec-026/wid-013/gad-026/..., never the training ids doc-011/rec-022/wid-022/gad-011/...), the bound action POSTs to the real fixture with HTTP status 200 and success=true, and verify() returns true; (b) NEGATIVE: out-of-support identifiers and missing-parameter bindings are refused with a recorded reason and a null bound action, and a wrong-intent request returns exactly ResolutionStatus.UNKNOWN with a null bound action; (c) COUNTERS: the inherited path reports retrieval_calls=1, verification_calls=1, repair_attempts=0 per positive execution and model_calls=model_tokens=0 throughout; (d) IDENTITY: the installed file sha256 equals 718efa6a... and `git hash-object src/spider/kernel.py` equals b15ed848... - with the pre-install shipped kernel (blob cfec98660b0277ccbf295e8a4119e8d81ddccf50) failing the same positive, so that promotion is enabled ONLY on independent audit PASS and blocker B1 (no promoted parameterized carrier) is discharged?
hypothesis: The installed carrier passes every frozen promotion certificate check (PROMOTION_READY). The mechanism itself was already experimentally established (EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064 / EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440: the parameterized path resolved EXECUTABLE on 40/40 held-out tasks on this exact substrate), and the install is byte-identical, so the only genuinely new risk is integration identity plus execution through the public `spider` package rather than a vendored copy; both are satisfied by construction and will be demonstrated, not assumed.
falsifier: Any single promotion certificate check fails: (PC1) installed file sha256 != 718efa6a... or git blob != b15ed848...; (PC2) on any held-out novelty-0.0 task the installed package does not distill_parameterized, does not resolve EXECUTABLE, returns a null bound action, returns confidence != 0.9, binds the wrong identifier, gets HTTP status != 200 / success != true, or verify() is false; (PC3) any out-of-support or missing-parameter case is not refused with a recorded reason and null bound action, or the wrong-intent case is not exactly ResolutionStatus.UNKNOWN; (PC4) the inherited-path counters differ from retrieval_calls=1, verification_calls=1, repair_attempts=0 per positive execution, or model_calls/model_tokens are non-zero; (PC5) the literal path (fresh registry populated only via the installed kernel's preserved literal distill(), confidence 0.5 < 0.8) reaches EXECUTABLE with a bound action on a held-out task, or an empty-registry resolve is not UNKNOWN; (PC6) the in-sample positive control is not 1.0; (PC7) the existing unit-test regression suite fails after install. A PC2 or PC3 failure would show the shipped package cannot consume the carrier; a PC5 failure would show the positive is not sensitive to the parameterized path.
baselines: B-PREINSTALL-KERNEL: the shipped pre-install kernel src/spider/kernel.py at base_sha 15c00119031eb27d658101de411e33413585b308 and HEAD (git blob cfec98660b0277ccbf295e8a4119e8d81ddccf50, sha256 46929b3a951df48d7f9d1fd850871073c0d91c1868aa117e13d389fe274e8d61) has zero occurrences of `distill_parameterized` (verified by `git show <sha>:src/spider/kernel.py | grep -c distill_parameterized` = 0) and its only path, literal `distill`, emits confidence 0.5 < default resolve min_confidence 0.8. Inherited empirical anchor: EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 B-LITERAL-KERNEL returned EXPLORE on 200/200 held-out tasks (success_rate 0.0; result.json.controls.B-LITERAL-KERNEL).

B-EMPTY-REGISTRY: installed kernel over an empty MechanismRegistry on the same held-out tasks; resolve must be UNKNOWN with a null bound action and no HTTP execution (inherited anchor: EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 B-EMPTIED-REGISTRY matched cold exactly; result.json.controls).

B-SYNTHETIC-CERT (external consistency, not re-run): the audited synthetic arm-differentiation certificate ARM-DIFFERENTIATION-CERTIFICATE-v1 of EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128 (verdict/audit PASS on a synthetic in-memory fixture). The real-substrate certificate here must be consistent with it; disagreement is a validity threat, not a re-measurement.
positive_control: PC-EXACT-REPLAY: using the installed kernel, re-run the 20 in-sample training tasks (5 per resource type x 2 types x 2 families) through the same distill_parameterized -> resolve -> real POST -> verify path. Expected: resolution EXECUTABLE with a non-null bound action, HTTP status 200, verify true for 20/20 (success_rate 1.0). Inherited anchor: EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 PC-EXACT-REPLAY = 20/20 success (result.json.controls.PC-EXACT-REPLAY). This proves the end-to-end machinery works before the held-out generalization claim is read.
null_control: N-EMPTY-REGISTRY: installed kernel with an empty registry on the held-out novelty-0.0 tasks must resolve exactly ResolutionStatus.UNKNOWN (reason 'no applicable validated mechanism') with bound_action=null and must issue zero POST requests. N-LITERAL-PATH: the installed kernel's preserved literal `distill` path (confidence 0.5, below the 0.8 execution threshold) must yield no EXECUTABLE resolution and no bound action on those tasks. Both nulls make the positive branch's dependence on `distill_parameterized` falsifiable.
measurement_validity: Substrate: the frozen credential-free localhost stdlib-HTTP fixture research/experiments/EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440/harness/substrate.py (sha256 0f9f9182cb90ac9e379000e4420a93ba2d2e6a167906c59bd9eac8a8392395af), SEED=42, two families F1 (documents/records) and F2 (widgets/gadgets), real HTTP request/response cycles, no in-memory shortcut, no external network, no credentials, no model and no browser.

Treatment binding: the carrier bytes are the frozen artifact research/experiments/EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440/harness/audited_spider/kernel.py (sha256 718efa6a..., git blob b15ed848...); EXECUTE installs exactly those bytes at src/spider/kernel.py and the certificate asserts sha256(file)==718efa6a and `git hash-object src/spider/kernel.py`==b15ed848 before and after the run.

Public-package import: the certificate imports `spider` from <repo>/src (the shipping package), asserts spider.kernel.__file__ resolves to src/spider/kernel.py, and never imports the parent experiment's vendored `audited_spider`, so the certificate measures the shipped package and not a research copy.

Unseen-identifier generalization: the positive branch uses only novelty-0.0 held-out test tasks whose identifiers (F1 doc-013/rec-026/..., F2 wid-013/gad-026/...) are disjoint from the training identifiers (doc-011/rec-022/wid-022/gad-011/...) and whose payload values (draft-5..draft-9) are disjoint from the training values (draft-0..draft-4). The induced support arithmetic is disclosed: training ids share the literal '-0' prefix with two-digit numeric remains, so the carrier induces an anchored support ^<type>-0[0-9]{2}$ and the held-out ids lie inside it; the held-out values lie inside ^draft-[0-9]{1}$. This is the declared regime and not a support-generalization claim beyond it.

Determinism: identifiers, tokens, revisions and scenarios are pure functions of SEED=42 and the task key (substrate.py); the certificate counters use only integer structural counters (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts). latency_ms/1000 is explicitly EXCLUDED from every certificate check, because the parent packet demonstrated that including it made its C3 criterion non-discriminating (EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 result.json.metrics.c3_c4_robustness).

Known-validity-threat carried forward from the parent (do not over-generalize): the carrier applies support predicates to free-form payload values; the substrate deliberately keeps the target value inside the induced value support. The certificate therefore establishes integration + unseen-identifier binding inside the induced support grammar, NOT support generalization for arbitrary free-form payloads.

Blinding/ordering: the pre-install blob and the carrier blob are recorded before the install; the install precedes all positive measurements; the identity assertions are re-run after the measurements. The certificate outcome is computed from the frozen checks, not chosen after looking at results.
decision_rule: The promotion certificate PROMOTION-CERTIFICATE-B1-v1 is the conjunction of seven stable checks, each PASS/FAIL: PC1-INSTALL-IDENTITY (installed src/spider/kernel.py sha256 == 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72 AND git hash-object == b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796 AND == the frozen artifact hash); PC2-POSITIVE-UNSEEN (for every novelty-0.0 held-out task: mechanism induced over >=3 observations, resolve EXECUTABLE, confidence == 0.9, bound_action non-null, bound identifier == task target identifier, real POST status 200 and success true, verify true; pass rate == 1.0 over the 10 held-out novelty-0.0 tasks); PC3-NEGATIVE-TAXONOMY (out-of-support identifier cases and missing-parameter cases each non-EXECUTABLE with bound_action null and a correct recorded reason, and wrong-intent cases exactly ResolutionStatus.UNKNOWN with bound_action null; pass rate == 1.0); PC4-COUNTER-HONESTY (per positive execution retrieval_calls == 1, verification_calls == 1, repair_attempts == 0; aggregate model_calls == 0 and model_tokens == 0; no injected events); PC5-ABLATION-SENSITIVITY (N-LITERAL-PATH: a fresh registry populated only via the installed kernel's preserved literal distill() over the training observations yields no EXECUTABLE resolution and no bound action on the held-out tasks (0/10, literal confidence 0.5 < 0.8); N-EMPTY-REGISTRY: resolve over an empty registry returns exactly UNKNOWN with a null bound action and zero POSTs; static pre-install identity: `git show <pre_execute_sha>:src/spider/kernel.py` contains zero occurrences of distill_parameterized); PC6-IN-SAMPLE-POSITIVE (PC-EXACT-REPLAY success_rate == 1.0 on 20/20 training tasks); PC7-UNIT-REGRESSION (tests/test_kernel.py passes with the installed kernel). Decision: if and only if PC1..PC7 all PASS -> certificate_overall=PASS and the packet is PROMOTION_READY (promote_to_product may be set true by the Director only on independent audit PASS). Otherwise certificate_overall=FAIL and the packet is NOT_PROMOTION_READY: no promotion, revert the src code to the pre-execute checkpoint, record which checks failed. Both branches are reachable: PC2/PC3 fail if the install or package path is wrong, PC5 fails if the positive is obtainable from the literal/empty path, PC4 fails on dishonest counters, PC1 fails on wrong bytes.
product_consequence_positive: If PROMOTION_READY and the independent audit returns PASS, the Director may set promote_to_product=true and advance C-PARAM-INHERIT (EXPERIMENTAL) toward PRODUCT_CORE; the shipped `spider` package then exposes distill_parameterized/resolve to external agents, blocker B1 is discharged, and C-LLM-INHERIT / residual-novelty economics experiments become constructible on top of a promoted carrier. The claim ceiling remains: unseen-identifier binding inside the induced support grammar on the deterministic credential-free REST class, with model_calls=0 by construction - it is a capability/promotion result, not a cost-reduction result.
product_consequence_negative: If NOT_PROMOTION_READY (or the audit does not PASS), no promotion occurs: promote_to_product stays false, C-PARAM-INHERIT stays EXPERIMENTAL, blocker B1 remains open, and the installed src change is reverted to the pre-execute checkpoint (scripts/revert_product_reject.py; execution_checkpoint.json.pre_execute_sha). The specific failing checks and their raw evidence are recorded so the next mandate can target the exact integration defect instead of re-running the economics certificate. The certificate criteria are not weakened after seeing outcomes.
estimated_cost: One local CPU run of a small deterministic certificate harness (stdlib only): <=2 families x (20 training + 10 held-out novelty-0.0 + ~12 negative resolves) tasks, real localhost HTTP on an ephemeral port, plus one unit-test invocation. No model calls, no tokens, no browser, no external network. Order of seconds to a couple of minutes of local compute; zero external cost.
expected_information_gain: Highest-leverage available Product step: the carrier mechanism is already measured, so this experiment isolates the single remaining unproven link - whether the frozen carrier can be installed byte-identically and consumed through the public shipped package on the real substrate. A PASS converts an experimental mechanism into a promotion-ready product capability (B1 discharged) and unblocks the C-LLM-INHERIT / residual-novelty economics thread; a FAIL localizes the integration defect and saves the flight by preventing an unverified promotion. Either result is decisive for the promotion decision, which no further re-run of the excluded dynamic-range economics certificate can be.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Both outcomes are reachable and the positive branch is empirically anchored. The parent packet already observed this exact substrate's parameterized path reaching EXECUTABLE 40/40 with retrieval_calls=1/verification_calls=1/repair_attempts=0, so PROMOTION_READY is attainable; the negative branch is reachable via the pre-install blob (no distill_parameterized), the preserved literal path (confidence 0.5 < 0.8 -> EXPLORE), the empty registry (UNKNOWN), and any install/identity error (PC1/PC2). No check is vacuous: PC5 explicitly requires the pre-install/literal/empty variants to fail the positive, so an insensitive positive is detectable.

control_sensitivity.reason: The positive control is expected to be exactly 1.0 on in-sample training tasks (20/20, observed in the parent), and the null/ablation controls are expected to be exactly non-executable: the pre-install kernel (literal confidence 0.5 < min 0.8) returned EXPLORE 200/200 in the parent, and an empty registry returns UNKNOWN. Because the ceiling and floor controls are known, the held-out positive check (PC2) is sensitive: it can only pass if the installed parameterized path actually generalizes to unseen in-support identifiers; if it passed trivially for the literal or empty variants, PC5 would fail.

treatment_liveness.reason: The treatment is structurally and empirically live, not merely asserted. Structurally: 5 successful update_resource observations per resource type (>=3, >= the kernel's 2-observation minimum), a single intent, varying URL identifier segment and varying json property/value fields, all required to induce non-empty parameter_slots; stable state fields become preconditions; _parameterized_confidence returns 0.9 >= default min_confidence 0.8, so resolve can reach EXECUTABLE. Empirically: the same carrier reached EXECUTABLE on 40/40 held-out tasks on this exact substrate in EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440.
